Definition: Jediael, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jediael = "God makes known"; 1) a chief patriarch of the tribe of Benjamin; maybe the same as 'Ashbel'; 2) the 2nd son of Meshelemiahand a Korahite gatekeeper; 3) son of Shimri and one of David's mighty warriors; 4) one of the chiefs of the thousands of Manasseh who joined David on his march to Ziklag; maybe the same man as 3 above
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
